summary: A car-ramming attack at a checkpoint in the Binyamin Brigade area of the West Bank seriously wounded Neria Leiter, son of Israel's ambassador to the US, prompting IDF to activate Division 98 headquarters in Judea and Samaria. Iran's senior military advisor Safavi declared readiness for a new phase of war with the United States, warning the conflict could extend to the Indian Ocean and Bab al-Mandab. IDF eliminated Hamas finance chief Muhammad Abu Alwan in Khan Younis, while artillery shelling was reported in southern Lebanon.
key_points: A car-ramming attack at a Binyamin Brigade checkpoint seriously wounded Neria Leiter, son of Israeli ambassador Yehiel Leiter; IDF forces at the scene eliminated the attacker. (Source: @manniefabian/59229)
IDF activated Division 98 headquarters in Judea and Samaria to command over the Binyamin and Etzion brigades, per directive of Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir. (Source: @New_security8200/203911)

Iran's senior military advisor General Safavi stated armed forces are prepared for a new phase of war with the US, with scenarios potentially extending to the Indian Ocean and Bab al-Mandab. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91429)
IDF eliminated Muhammad Abu Alwan, head of Hamas finances, in Khan Younis, praised by PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz. (Source: @New_security8200/203899)

Iranian President Pezeshkian addressed UNGA, stating Iran defended itself against US and Israeli attacks and will not flee from peace negotiations, while warning about Strait of Hormuz access. (Source: @VahidOnline/78501)
Marco Rubio accused Iran and its proxies of deliberately bombing the US embassy in Kuwait, calling attacks on diplomatic facilities unprecedented. (Source: @kianmeli1/92409)
Explosions were heard in the Iranian cities of Sirik and Bandar Abbas. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81362)

sections.executive_summary: A car-ramming attack at a Binyamin Brigade checkpoint in the West Bank seriously wounded Neria Leiter, son of Israel's ambassador to the US, prompting IDF to activate Division 98 headquarters across Judea and Samaria. Iran's senior military advisor General Safavi declared readiness for a new phase of war with the United States, warning the conflict could extend from the Persian Gulf to the Indian Ocean and Bab al-Mandab. IDF eliminated Hamas finance chief Muhammad Abu Alwan in Khan Younis, while artillery shelling was reported in southern Lebanon near Beit Yahoun and Bar'ashit.

points: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the 81st UNGA session, stating that the US and Israel attacked Iran with advanced equipment and Iran defended itself with strength. He emphasized Iran will not flee from peace negotiations but will not accept the language of force, and warned that closing the Strait of Hormuz to Iran while others use it is unacceptable. (Source: @VahidOnline/78501)

General Safavi, senior assistant and advisor to the commander of the Islamic Revolution, stated that Iran's armed forces are prepared for a new phase of potential war with the United States. He said the armed forces have prepared plans for worst-case scenarios, and if the US and Zionists attack again, the war front will be wider, potentially extending to the Indian Ocean. He also noted Ansar Allah has made significant progress in weapons production. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91429)
Explosions were heard in the Iranian cities of Sirik and Bandar Abbas, though no further details on the cause or casualties were provided in the source message. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81362)
Mohsen Rezaei issued threats against countries that do not allow Iranian aircraft to land, though specific details of the threat were not elaborated in the message. (Source: @kianmeli1/92408)

Scott Bessent reportedly stated that more than 80-90 percent of international flights from Iran have been suspended, raising questions about how Iranian UN representatives will return to their country. (Source: @mamlekate/104606)
A tanker tracking report indicated approximately 6 million barrels of seized Iranian crude oil are being covertly transported to the United States. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81367)

US military aircraft movements included Coronet East missions with F-35A and F-15E jets transiting through RAF Lakenheath to CENTCOM, though multiple tanker issues caused delays and diversions, including F-15E jets diverting to Chania. (Source: @shin_persian/10373)

A car-ramming attack at a checkpoint in the Binyamin Brigade area seriously wounded reservist soldier Neria Leiter, son of Israeli ambassador to the US Yehiel Leiter. Another of Leiter's sons, Moshe, was killed fighting Hamas in northern Gaza in November 2023. IDF forces at the checkpoint eliminated the attacker. (Source: @manniefabian/59229)

Neria Leiter underwent life-saving treatment in the trauma unit followed by a complex brain surgery lasting several hours. His condition remains very serious and life-threatening, with surgical and ICU teams continuing treatment. (Source: @New_security8200/203917)

Per directive of Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir, IDF activated Division 98 headquarters in Judea and Samaria, taking command of the Binyamin and Etzion brigades to strengthen command and control and enhance defensive and offensive capabilities amid recent events. (Source: @New_security8200/203911)

IDF eliminated Muhammad Abu Alwan, head of the finance department of Hamas, in Khan Younis. PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz praised the IDF and Shin Bet for the precise operation. (Source: @New_security8200/203899)
IDF forces from the 228th Brigade completed their mission in Syria, destroying dozens of infrastructure targets and weapons in the security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/25186)

Binyamin Brigade commander Colonel Anan Faras addressed forces after the attack, instructing them to return to their missions and maintain vigilance, stating the attack could happen again. (Source: @inon_yttach/10057)
PM Netanyahu is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly at 21:00 Israel time. (Source: @New_security8200/203919)

A car-ramming attack at a Binyamin Brigade checkpoint in the West Bank seriously wounded reservist soldier Neria Leiter. IDF forces at the scene eliminated the terrorist who accelerated toward a police vehicle near the checkpoint. Large IDF forces deployed to the area and established roadblocks. (Source: @New_security8200/203906)
At the Maccabim checkpoint, a soldier was critically wounded and treated by medical forces; the report confirmed the casualty was an IDF soldier. (Source: @pkpoi/144045)
In the Hebron Hills area, a group of smugglers attempted to run over a settler, who opened fire and wounded one of them in the leg. (Source: @pkpoi/144042)

The Popular Front stated the Peace Council ignores ongoing Israeli massacres in Gaza and provides cover for continued genocide. It warned that limiting discussions to the weapons file represents a reversal of the ceasefire agreement and UN Security Council Resolution 2803, and demanded mediators and Arab states reject using the Peace Council to achieve Israeli war objectives. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394483)

Balad chairman Sami Abu Shahada again refused to designate Hamas as a terrorist organization. (Source: @amitsegal/65141)

Artillery shelling was also reported targeting Bar'ashit in southern Lebanon, according to live mapping. (Source: @redlinkleb/44670)

General Safavi referenced the linkage between the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea, and between the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab, as potentially changing the war theater, suggesting a new front could emerge centered on the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab if the US starts a new war. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91429)
Marco Rubio accused Iran and its proxies of attacking diplomatic facilities, stating they deliberately bombed the US embassy in Kuwait, calling it unprecedented. (Source: @kianmeli1/92409)
Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi met with his Pakistani counterpart Ishaq Dar on the sidelines of the 81st UNGA session. (Source: @presstv/208046)

Pezeshkian warned at UNGA that the deployment of hostile fleets and expansion of war in the Strait of Hormuz does not contribute to shipping security, stating all should benefit from the strait or none will. (Source: @VahidOnline/78501)

sections.threat_assessment: The activation of IDF Division 98 headquarters in Judea and Samaria signals a significant escalation in Israeli military posture in the West Bank following the car-ramming attack that wounded the ambassador's son. Iran's General Safavi's explicit declaration of readiness for a new war phase with the US, combined with threats to extend the conflict to the Indian Ocean and Bab al-Mandab, represents a direct escalation of regional threats. The reported bombing of the US embassy in Kuwait, if confirmed, marks an unprecedented Iranian attack on diplomatic facilities that could trigger a broader US response. The near-total suspension of international flights from Iran suggests ongoing operational disruptions that may indicate preemptive security measures or escalating tensions.
sections.regional_response: Iranian President Pezeshkian's UNGA speech attempted to balance defiance with diplomatic openness, stating Iran defended itself against US-Israeli attacks while not fleeing from peace negotiations. Iranian FM Araghchi's meeting with Pakistani counterpart Dar suggests ongoing diplomatic outreach to regional partners. The Popular Front's rejection of the Peace Council's approach to Gaza reflects Palestinian faction resistance to international frameworks that do not address Israeli withdrawal. US draft statements condemning UK, France, and Canada over settlement import blocks, though unreleased, indicate continued US alignment with Israeli positions on West Bank issues.
sections.intelligence_notes: The near-simultaneous reports of explosions in Sirik and Bandar Abbas, combined with the covert transfer of approximately 6 million barrels of seized Iranian oil to the US, suggest active interdiction operations against Iranian assets. US military aircraft movements through RAF Lakenheath to CENTCOM, including F-35A and F-15E jets, indicate ongoing force rotations despite logistical difficulties with tanker support. The Lebanese Army drone flight over Dahieh is notable as an unusual monitoring activity in Hezbollah's stronghold. IDF 228th Brigade's completed mission in Syria destroying dozens of infrastructure targets confirms sustained Israeli operations beyond its borders.
